title: System status
refreshTip: Measure processes and disk space again now (takes about a second)

meta.uptimeSub: The server itself has been up for {host}.
meta.liveTip: The page asks again every 15 seconds while it is visible. The history lives in memory only: it starts over after a restart.

verdict.okText: Server and bot have room to spare: no lasting load, enough memory and space.
verdict.warmingUp: Not enough measurements yet - the assessment follows after about a minute.
verdict.warmingUpPartial: Only a few measurements yet - CPU and memory are judged after about a minute.

otherProcess.text: Another process is loading the server: {hostCpu} CPU in total, the bot itself only {botCpu}.
otherProcess.named: Another process is loading the server: "{process}" takes {processCpu} CPU, {hostCpu} in total, the bot itself only {botCpu}.
otherProcess.advice: Check what this process does - or move it to a server of its own. A bigger server only helps if it has to keep running.

botBottleneck.cpu: The bot itself is the bottleneck: it keeps {procCpu} of one CPU core busy.
botBottleneck.loop: The bot itself is the bottleneck: requests wait up to {loopP99} for each other (over 200 ms in {loopShare} of the measurements).
botBottleneck.advice: More cores hardly help - Node computes on one core. Optimise the slowest requests; a faster core helps a little.

hostBusy.text: The server is busy: {hostCpu} CPU, {botCpu} of it from the bot ({cores} cores).
hostBusy.advice: Keep an eye on it. If it stays like this, a server with more or faster cores helps.

cpuOverloaded.text: CPU overloaded: load {load5} (5 minutes) and {load15} (15 minutes) on {cores} cores - more work is waiting than there are cores.
cpuOverloaded.advice: More CPU cores or a bigger server.

memoryLow.ram: Not enough memory: only {memAvailPct} available ({memAvail} of {memTotal}).
memoryLow.swap: Not enough memory: the swap space is {swapUsedPct} full - that slows everything down.
memoryLow.advice: More RAM or a bigger server.

diskLow.text: Disk almost full: only {freePct} free ({free} of {total}).
diskLow.advice: Clean up old reports and data under data/ or book more disk space.

tiles.noSample: The first measurement comes 15 seconds after the start.
tiles.hostCpuTip: Load of all CPU cores of the server
tiles.hostCpuSub: Everything that runs on the server - the bot and every other process.
tiles.procCpuTip: CPU of the bot process, relative to one core
tiles.procCpuSub: 100 % means one core is full. Node computes on one core - from there on every request waits.
tiles.memTip: Memory that programs can still get
tiles.loopTip: How long a request has to wait in the bot before its turn
tiles.loopSub2: 99 % of the waits of the last 15 seconds were shorter. From 200 ms on it shows in the menu.
tiles.diskTip: Free space on the disk of the data directory
tiles.diskSub2: Measured again at most every 5 minutes.

routes.title: Slowest requests
routes.tip: Every page and every API request, measured in the bot. Ids and tokens in the path are replaced by :id. Slow means: {ms} ms or more.
routes.empty: No requests in this time span yet.
routes.noSlow: No request took longer than {ms} ms since the start.

procs.title: Processes on the server
procs.tip: The processes with the most CPU in the second of the measurement. Name and number only - no command lines.
procs.tipPs: The processes with the most CPU according to ps - there it is the average since the process started. Name and number only - no command lines.
procs.cpuTip: Share of one core; over 100 % means more than one core

disk.title: Disk space
disk.tip: The biggest folders and files in the bot's data directory (data/).
disk.truncated: Very many files - the sizes are lower bounds.
disk.noSpace: The free space of the disk cannot be measured here.

backup.title: Backup
backup.tip: Three parts of the backup: the snapshot on this server, the encrypted off-site copy and the restore test. The overall picture is only as good as the worst part.
backup.tipSub: Snapshots cannot be downloaded on purpose: they contain API keys and sessions.
backup.nowTip: Takes a snapshot of the data right away (on top of the hourly one)
backup.locked: A backup is already running – please wait a moment.
backup.loadFailed: The backup status could not be loaded.
backup.disabled: Hourly snapshots are off on this instance (BACKUP_ENABLED=1 turns them on).

partTips.snapshot: The last snapshot of the data on this server
partTips.offsite: The last encrypted copy in the cloud
partTips.restoreTest: The last check that the backup can really be restored

limits.snapshot: Green under 26 hours, yellow under 48 hours, red above.
limits.restoreTest: Green under 8 days, yellow under 15 days, red above.
